scenarios.purpose: No preference/history: deterministic order and limit
scenarios.fact_basis: Authored fixture only. 106 is unavailable; absent optional filters allow unknown fields. B0 ID order precedes limit.

scenarios.purpose: Category, budget, ABV and explicit exclusion stay mandatory
scenarios.fact_basis: 103 has the wrong category; 104 lacks price; 105 lacks category/ABV; 106 is unavailable; 108 is excluded. 101/102/107 meet inclusive bounds.

scenarios.purpose: Inclusive boundaries with a smaller return limit
scenarios.fact_basis: 102 is on the upper bounds; 108 is on the lower bounds. Exclude 101, unknown 104/105, unavailable 106, and below-min 107. eligible_count remains 3.

scenarios.purpose: A zero upper bound is active and distinct from unknown
scenarios.fact_basis: Only 107 has known price 0 and ABV 0. Unknown fields do not become 0. Both bound reason codes must be present.

scenarios.purpose: Missing optional features do not exclude otherwise valid candidates
scenarios.fact_basis: 104 has an unknown price but the requested category is known. There is no price/ABV filter, so those reason codes are absent.

scenarios.purpose: No candidate means explicit empty result without relaxation
scenarios.fact_basis: No authored product has this category. Expected fallback reason is no_eligible_products, not a relaxed recommendation.

scenarios.purpose: Excluded candidates are not reintroduced to fill the list
scenarios.fact_basis: Every authored candidate is explicitly excluded. Expected fallback reason is no_eligible_products.

scenarios.purpose: An empty explicit catalog has a valid empty response
scenarios.fact_basis: There are no input candidates. Expected eligible_count 0 and no_eligible_products.
